output: • in_channels: 6. The base config feeds real point features (`point_features: observation`, 6 per
point), so the encoder reads those instead of the constant ones of its preset.
• grouper: preset `cylinder-invres` (LocalGroup). Seed cylinder crop followed by the inverted
proposal  ScoredSeeds           base config, objectness left to the view stage
uses it: every seed is classified as object or background and takes the best of 300 template
views, in training and in inference.
• proposal: ScoredSeeds with select_by: graspness_only, num_seeds: 1024, graspness_threshold: 0.1,
graspness_loss: {type: SmoothL1, weight: 10.0, beta: 1.0}, in place of GraspnessFPS, which has
no option to leave the 'objectness' to another stage (ScoredSeeds: Objectness and graspness per
point; the selecting score, the cut and the sampler are options.). GraspnessFPS and
ObjectnessViewStage both predict the 'objectness' of a seed, and a detector needs one owner for
it: ObjectnessViewStage owns it, and the proposal neither predicts nor supervises it. This
changes the proposal; `--no-adapter` leaves the pair refused.
✗ view · assigner [structural]: ObjectnessViewStage computes its targets from 'dense' matched
labels, but CompactLabelAssigner returns 'compact' ones. View stages that read 'compact' labels:
✗ refused: nothing was written. The messages above name the conflict and a fix.
